# Scaliver Official

> India's instant game top-up platform for Mobile Legends, PUBG UC, BGMI UC, and Free Fire with automatic UPI payment verification.

Scaliver Official lets gamers buy in-game currency (diamonds, UC, etc.) via UPI. Payments are auto-verified through the Chuimei gateway, and orders are fulfilled instantly via the Aluu.in provider API. A wallet/coin system (1 coin = ₹1) is also available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Browse Mobile Legends, mobile games, and social media top-up products.
- [Wallet](/wallet): Check coin balance and transactions.
- [Add Coins](/add-coin): Recharge wallet via UPI.
- [Orders](/orders): View order history and live status.
- [Redeem](/redeem): Apply gift / promo codes.
- [Sign in](/auth): Login or register (email or phone OTP).
- [Profile](/profile): Manage account details.
